rootCauseHypothesis:
The click action likely hangs because the 'Next motorcycle' control is not becoming interactable or the click handler is blocking for too long on the hosted page. This can happen if an overlay, modal backdrop, loading state, or CSS layer intercepts pointer events, or if the carousel navigation depends on a slow/stuck asynchronous operation (image fetch, state update, re-render, or animation) that prevents the browser automation watchdog from observing completion within 15 seconds. Underlying error: Test failed at step 6 (click) — Click the 'Next motorcycle' button (aria-label 'Next motorcycle') to advance the carousel and verify the active motorcycle name and top-center badge update to the next model.

Error: Failed to click element 75: Event handler browser_use.browser.watchdog_base.DefaultActionWatchdog.on_ClickElementEvent#7312(?▶ ClickElementEvent#972a 🏃) timed out after 15.0s

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Inspect the carousel's 'Next motorcycle' button for a front-end click blocker or long-running handler. Common hosting-side fixes are: remove any overlay/spinner that may sit above the button, ensure the button is not disabled or hidden behind a zero-opacity element, avoid synchronous work in the click handler, and make the carousel update purely client-side without waiting on a stalled network request. If the button is implemented with animations, reduce transition duration or ensure pointer events remain enabled. Also verify the button has the correct aria-label and an immediate onClick response so automated clicks do not time out.
